summary: Three actual child agents completed overlapping read-only GPT-6 Sol/medium tasks under on-request/auto_review. Actual GitHub README and MIT license access and local source reads were verified. The parent received child results but its next prompt-attachment stage stalled in one unresponsive DEV renderer; the parent did not aggregate or close the children. Content-free CDP checks showed other pages and the launcher responsive, while a renderer consumed approximately five CPU seconds in a five-second observation. The 60-second stage deadline remained blocked awaiting the browser action/cleanup for approximately 496 seconds. Closing only the verified owned task tab cancelled the turn and restored an idle queue. All 551 source-copy file hashes were unchanged. The initial renderer hang is not attributed to the prior network interruption; unbounded stage settlement is a separate reproducible code risk to repair.
